  from  : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|hps_axi_slave:bridge|cfg_clk_div[4]
  to    : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_biu:u_biu|t1_half2
  k = 0.5000   slack =   +8.988   ->  T_min  13.274 ns  =    75.34 MHz

  observation endpoints (incl. core_ad_hold if RETENTION): 64

==========================================================================
 THE LADDER BEHIND THE BINDING CONE
==========================================================================

 ⚠ EVERY RUNG IS RESTRICTED TO divclk -> divclk.  Quartus's own Fmax
   Summary note says FMAX is computed ONLY for paths whose source and
   destination are driven by the SAME clock, so a cross-domain path
   (the JTAG hub, the HPS bridge) is not a divclk ceiling and must not
   be quoted as one.  A first run of this script without the filter
   returned the sld_jtag_hub at rung 2; that hit is EXCLUDED here for
   that reason, and this note is why.

--- RUNG 1: not latching in an observation register ---
  from  : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|hps_axi_slave:bridge|cfg_clk_div[4]
  to    : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_biu:u_biu|t1_half2
  k = 0.5000   slack =   +8.988   ->  T_min  13.274 ns  =    75.34 MHz

--- RUNG 1a: ...and not t1_half2 either (the worst k=1 survivor) ---
  from  : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|c_int_q
  to    : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_eu:u_eu|row_posted~DUPLICATE
  k = 1.0000   slack =   +9.129   ->  T_min  22.121 ns  =    45.21 MHz

--- RUNG 2: ...and not launching from c_int_q ---
  from  : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|hps_axi_slave:bridge|cfg_clk_div[4]
  to    : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_biu:u_biu|t1_half2
  k = 0.5000   slack =   +8.988   ->  T_min  13.274 ns  =    75.34 MHz

--- RUNG 3: ...and not latching in row_posted ---
  from  : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|hps_axi_slave:bridge|cfg_clk_div[4]
  to    : emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_biu:u_biu|t1_half2
  k = 0.5000   slack =   +8.988   ->  T_min  13.274 ns  =    75.34 MHz

==========================================================================
 TRUE CEILING over the five classes: T_min 22.121 ns = 45.21 MHz
   bound by: RUNG 1a: ...and not t1_half2 either (the worst k=1 survivor)   (emu:emu|system_large:system_large|c_int_q -> emu:emu|system_large:system_large|v30_core:u_core|v30u_eu:u_eu|row_posted~DUPLICATE)
==========================================================================

 Compare against Quartus's OWN Fmax Summary in <rev>.sta.rpt, which is
 the authority.  Its note says it scales the rising and falling edges
 along with FMAX, so it handles the negedge destination itself.
